registry.rules: Conservative union of prepared training/candidate conversations and selected evaluation identifier fields in declared workspace roots. Indexed corpus files, weights, archives and reserved research_reader_v1 are not read. Prepared data is excluded even when optimizer use is unproven. No pretraining/remote-history claim.

policy: Official train only for updates. Prior training-only pool reuse is disclosed, not fresh evaluation or proof of optimizer exposure. Any validation/evaluation membership overrides reuse. All old reward diagnostics excluded. New reward/model validation uses locally unexposed official-validation papers, mutually disjoint. Selected target identifiers count; full indexed-corpus membership alone does not.
history_scope: Same hash-verified files from before this pool was prepared; current pool artifacts are not retroactively classified as earlier exposure. Question-only prior validation/evaluation records exclude the entire mapped paper.
